readout_other: apomorphine-induced rotation; cylinder test; TH immunohistochemistry; western blot (GDNF, BDNF, LCN2, IL-1beta)
direction_notes: LIPUS improved rotation and forepaw bias, increased TH staining and GDNF in the ipsilateral SNpc and reduced LCN2 and IL-1beta in 6-OHDA lesioned rats; neuroprotective aim, excitation or inhibition not assessed.

target.label: the targeted region in the lesions of the brain

timing.protocol_description: Each right hemisphere received triple sonications of 5 min with a 5 min interval between sonications, 5 days per week for 6 weeks (weeks 3 to 8), under isoflurane.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twelve hours after the last sonication, 4 rats each group were sacrificed for analysis of LCN2 protein expression (Fig. 5A).

flags.reason: Only per-group n is given (n = 8 for behaviour, n = 4 for histology and western blot); 50 rats received 6-OHDA and 18 were excluded. Recorded the LIPUS group size from the behaviour figure legend.
Paper writes 'spatial-peak, temporal-average intensity (I )' with the subscript lost in extraction; read as Ispta. Measured by radiation force balance in degassed water.
Each sonication is 5 min, three per session with 5 min gaps; 5 days per week for 6 weeks. Number of sessions not stated.
Rats were 'divided into' groups; randomisation is not stated.
Behavioural testing and TH quantification were by a blinded investigator; treatment blinding not described.
